channel.title: EBK Deep Bag
channel.description: Sports research from Elite Ball Knowledge: real data, matched comparisons, and the myths that don't survive them.

item.title: The Fresh-Start Myth
item.description: We matched 243 NFL trades against similar players who stayed put. The new city barely registered. Players handed a smaller job fell about 3.5 fantasy points a game behind, under every method we tried.

item.title: Champagne, No Hangover
item.description: Champions get worse the year after a title, and so do the teams they most resemble. Across 352 title winners in four leagues, champions in the NBA and NHL, and probably the NFL, fell less far than equally good teams that didn’t win.

item.title: Payback Is a Rounding Error
item.description: Across 1,547 NFL games against a former team, the revenge bump comes to about a third of a fantasy point. Home field is worth about the same.

item.title: The Cliff
item.description: Running backs go over it at 29. Hockey skaters hang on until 32 or later. Both ages come from rebuilding the aging curves for 14 position groups in four leagues, this time counting the players who quietly vanished from the data.
